name: UCSF SEP High School Intern Program
org: UCSF Science and Health Education Partnership
what_you_do: You do a paid eight-week summer research internship at UCSF with a scientist mentor. The program also includes college counseling and a trip to a college campus.
who_can_apply: Current juniors at an SFUSD high school or an SF public charter school, no exceptions. Grades and science background are not used to pick students; low-income and first-generation college students are encouraged.
pay_detail: $4,500 paid after completing the program (35 hours a week for 8 weeks)
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Jan 15, 2027 and are due Feb 15, 2027 per the page's timeline. The page's FAQ still says Feb 8, so apply by Feb 8 to be safe.
how_to_apply: Fill in the interest form to hear when the application opens, then submit the online application. About 50 students are interviewed for 25 spots; results come by email in April.
notes: The last-year notice on the SEP page is for Teen Wellness Connection, not this job. Questions: SandraPatricia.Arriaga@ucsf.edu or (415) 502-6324.
